```yaml
name: Unit Tests

# Runs on all pushes and PRs to staging branch
on:
  push:
    branches: [staging]
  pull_request:
    branches: [staging]

jobs:
  test:
    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run unit tests with coverage
        id: test
        run: |
          bun run test:ci
        continue-on-error: false
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_PATH: test.db

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          file: ./coverage/lcov.info
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella

      - name: Post coverage results to PR
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: marocchino/sticky-pull-request-comment@v2
        with:
          header: test-results
          message: |
            ## 🧪 Unit Test Results
            
            - ✅ **Tests Passed:** ${{ steps.test.outputs.passed }}
            - ❌ **Tests Failed:** ${{ steps.test.outputs.failed }}
            - 📊 **Coverage (Functions):** ${{ steps.test.outputs.coverage-functions }}
            - 📊 **Coverage (Lines):** ${{ steps.test.outputs.coverage-lines }}
            
            [View detailed test results](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }})
            
            <details>
            <summary>Click here to see full output</summary>
            
            ```
            ${{ steps.test.outputs.full-output }}
            ```
            
            </details>

      - name: Archive coverage artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-report
          path: coverage/
          retention-days: 30
```
